critical_insights.insight_1: RPS follows STRICT PATTERN: ~30 pages front matter, then 31 groups each with illustration(s) followed by parts list(s), then ~3 pages back matter
critical_insights.insight_2: Content distribution is nearly perfect 50/50: ~450 illustrations, ~450 parts lists, ~30 administrative pages
critical_insights.insight_3: Each group is SELF-CONTAINED: all callouts on illustration pages match item numbers on parts list pages within same group
critical_insights.insight_4: Group codes are CONSISTENT: each page clearly shows group title at top, making automated scanning feasible
critical_insights.insight_5: Illustration pages always appear BEFORE parts list pages for each group (consistent ordering)
critical_insights.insight_6: Most illustration pages have numbered callouts (1-100+ range depending on complexity)
critical_insights.insight_7: Parts list pages use ITEM NO column that directly corresponds to callout numbers on illustrations

recommendations_for_barry.recommendation_1: Build group-based index: Create lookup table GROUP_CODE → [illustration_pages] → [parts_list_pages]
recommendations_for_barry.recommendation_2: Extract callout ranges: For each group, automatically extract min/max callout numbers from illustrations
recommendations_for_barry.recommendation_3: Create reverse index: CALLOUT_NUMBER → GROUP_CODE → ITEM_NUMBER → DESCRIPTION
recommendations_for_barry.recommendation_4: Cache CDN URLs: Pre-generate all 930 PNG CDN paths for instant access
recommendations_for_barry.recommendation_5: Implement smart highlighting: When showing illustration, highlight specific callout number based on query
recommendations_for_barry.recommendation_6: Support package queries: Return illustration + corresponding parts lists as coordinated 'packages' for each group
